Watch all 15 of Cole Caufield's regular-season overtime game-winning goals! From his first NHL goal to his latest record-breaking winner, relive every clutch moment from the Montreal Canadiens' electrifying goal scorer.
Caufield made NHL history on November 5, 2026, becoming the fastest player ever to reach 15 career overtime goals, doing so in just 384 games and surpassing Connor McDavid's previous record of 559 games.
Which goal is your favorite? Let us know in the comments!
